name: project-board-organizer
description: Use when someone wants a messy project board (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Trello, Notion, or Jira) audited and cleaned up: tasks rewritten for a specific audience and sections reorganized, with a preview before anything changes.

name: prospect-automation
description: Use when a user wants prospect automation: turn a contact list or signal/ICP brief into sourced companies, decision-makers, business-email candidates and proof-backed SURE/Review/Rejected CSV or Sheet outputs.

name: Social media cleanup
description: Use when someone wants to clean up their public social media (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube): find and remove offensive posts, replies, likes, or comments (hate speech, homophobia, antisemitism, misogyny, racism, slurs) and unfollow porn or adult accounts.

name: typesafe-ai
description: Use when building typed AI judgments with TypeSafe/Jev (routing, ranking, extraction, verification, scrap quality gates) \u2014 boolean/choice/score primitives via Vercel AI Gateway instead of prompt-and-parse.
